summary: Verified TTV (Time-to-Value) feature end-to-end: backend /api/ttv/milestones endpoint, Dashboard ttv-tracker widget, OnboardingWizard step 4 onb-ttv-preview, /onboarding route, and all related regression flows. 8/8 backend tests passed and frontend integration verified via Playwright.
passed_tests: GET /api/ttv/milestones returns 5 milestones with correct shape (signup, first_lead, first_aria, first_meeting, first_won)
Endpoint returns completed_count, total_milestones=5, progress_pct, ttv_to_meeting, signup_at
Endpoint requires JWT auth (returns 401/403 without token)
Negative durations between historical milestones and current signup return null for time_from_start (no negative '-' string)
Dashboard renders [data-testid=ttv-tracker] at progress 80% (4/5 milestones complete) with progress bar, milestone steps, time_from_start chip (42m for ARIA convo)
Step 4 renders [data-testid=onb-ttv-preview] with all 5 milestone rows (Account Created, First Lead Captured, First ARIA Conversation, First Meeting Booked, First Deal Won)
Launch Dashboard button [data-testid=onb-launch-btn] posts /api/onboarding/complete and navigates to /
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3105 lines — should be split into modules (auth, leads, ttv, onboarding, etc.). Already flagged in past iterations.
TTV endpoint correctly excludes mongodb _id via projection {'_id': 0}.
TTV time_diff_human catches all exceptions broadly with 'except:' — consider 'except Exception:' for clarity (minor).
Onboarding 'All Set!' summary shows raw 'Company:' and 'Founder:' labels with empty values when user uses Skip path — minor cosmetic but acceptable since skip implies no data.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_TTV_CO onboarding record via POST /api/onboarding/complete (acceptable, idempotent for admin user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: TTV feature is fully working. Dashboard widget hides when progress_pct=100. Step 4 onb-ttv-preview is a static preview (1/5 done hardcoded) not live API-driven — by design. /onboarding route works under ProtectedRoute. Only /api/ttv/milestones is dynamic.
